title: Claims reconciliation platform
summary: OCR and LLM platform that matches distributor claims spreadsheets against invoices and proofs, applies policy rules, detects duplicates, recalculates amounts, routes uncertain lines to an exception queue and keeps an audit trail. Finance keeps final approval.
publish_status: Needs client permission before naming or adding numbers

title: Agentic AI penetration-testing platform
summary: Supervisor-based multi-agent platform for endpoint discovery, attack-surface mapping, OWASP Top 10 and business-logic testing, live vulnerability validation and exploit-chain evidence.

title: AutoSentinx: voice agent red-teaming
summary: Autonomous red-team and compliance testing for Hindi and Hinglish voice agents, with multi-turn adversarial playbooks and PASS/RISK/FAIL evidence mapped to OWASP LLM and agentic risks, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, and RBI, DPDP and TRAI-style requirements.

title: LLM endpoint security scanner
summary: Workflow that scans Azure-hosted and custom HTTP LLM endpoints for prompt injection, jailbreaks and data leakage.

title: AI remediation pipeline
summary: Pipeline that turns security findings into remediation patches and pull requests for developer review.

title: WhatsApp hotel booking assistant
summary: WhatsApp Cloud API booking flow with availability checks, room, date and guest selection, rates, UPI or QR payment, confirmation and a room catalogue.

title: RERA project data aggregator
summary: Playwright scraper that collects state RERA project listings and full project details into structured Excel output.
